Core

Card

Program/school card: media, eyebrow, title, description, footer. Class contract: .rse-card.

Live example

The example needs JavaScript; the usage below shows the markup.

Usage

Content card for programs, schools, or news — image, category tag, eyebrow, title, description, footer slot (e.g. a Button or Badge).

<Card
  image={<img src="photo.jpg" alt="Estudantes em sala de aula" />}
  tag={<Tag color="green">Educação Infantil</Tag>}
  eyebrow="Rede Sesc"
  title="Colégio Sesc de Ensino Médio"
  description="Formação integral com foco em protagonismo estudantil."
  footer={<Button size="sm" variant="secondary">Saiba mais</Button>}
/>

Pass href to make the card a link: the title becomes the link and its hit area covers the card, so the whole card is clickable while a footer button stays its own control (never nest a control in a link). Linked cards lift on hover. Without href the card is static — use that when the footer holds the only action. Use <image-slot> as the image placeholder in prototypes.

Without React: <article class="rse-card"> with .rse-card__media, .rse-card__body, .rse-card__eyebrow, .rse-card__title > a.rse-card__link, .rse-card__description, .rse-card__footer.

Props

PropTypeRequiredNotes
imageReact.ReactNode—Optional media element (e.g. <image-slot> or <img>) rendered at 16:10
eyebrowstring—
titleReact.ReactNodeyes
descriptionstring—
tagReact.ReactNode—Optional Tag/Badge element shown above the eyebrow
footerReact.ReactNode—Actions or meta below the body; stays independently clickable
hrefstring—Makes the title a link whose hit area covers the whole card
headingLevel2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6—Heading level of the title (default 3)

Also accepts every attribute of Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>, 'title'>, a ref and className.

Component tokens

Set any of these on :root or an ancestor to re-skin Card without touching its CSS. Each defaults to a role token, so it follows the theme. Use a role or palette token as the new value, and keep its pairs in scripts/contrast-pairs.mjs passing.

TokenDefaultLightDarkContrast
--rse-card-bg{rse.color.surface-card}#ffffff#24232f#ffffff
--rse-card-border{rse.color.border-subtle}#e4e2d9#34323f#5b5866
--rse-card-radius{rse.radius.lg}24px24px24px
--rse-card-shadow{rse.shadow.sm}0 1px 2px rgba(43,42,61,0.08)0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.45)none
--rse-card-shadow-hover{rse.shadow.md}0 8px 24px rgba(43,42,61,0.10)0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.5)none
